# Scoreboard (public sets)

<!-- Generated by scripts/scoreboard_page.py from the results store (scoreboard/): run it again rather than edit this page. -->

The early scoreboard (stage 3 of the [grading method](method-1.0.md), section 14): every local configuration of each reference pack, on each of its public scoring sets (its `test` set, its enriched set and that set's holdout), and each remote configuration run by hand as its arm's declared one (section 10). This page is generated from the results store, `scoreboard/` in the repository, and from nothing else, so the same store gives the same page ([running and checking the scoreboard](../operations/scoreboard.md)).

!!! warning "Engineering evaluation, not clinical validation"
    Every set here is public: it is in the repository and in the package, so anything can be tuned to it. Each table is a regression check, not a ranking. No figure orders its columns, and nothing here is graded: grades are given only on frozen hidden sets.

Sites' own evaluations of a pack, shared as signed counts, are shown on the Hub, in each pack's Site evidence section. None of them is on this page, in any table or any grade: sites choose their own cases, and a ticket binds a dataset before its run, not how its cases were chosen.

- **0 current results** (0 superseded results listed at the end), 0 signed. A result reads "unsigned" until the owner signs it ([verifying a result](verifying.md)).
- **"method draft, not in effect":** the method has no effective date yet.
- **Stale:** each result shows the day it goes stale, 45 days after it was measured, as "stale after DATE". It reads "stale: pack changed", "stale: set changed" or "stale: method changed" when the pack, the set or the method is no longer the one it was measured on. A stale result is run again, never edited, and the new one supersedes it.
- **Insufficient evidence:** a table whose critical label has fewer distinct positives than the method's minimum carries the banner, naming each such label.
- **Not measured:** an arm, or a configuration of a measured arm, that no result covers yet.
- **Remote configurations** (section 10) are run by hand, never in CI, as their arm's declared configuration (`scoreboard/declared/`), in 3 to 5 replicates: replicate 1 is the headline, with the case flip rate between any two replicates and the spread of each figure in its column (not its subgroups', which move only where cases flip). A result keeps the statements `scoreboard/disclosures.json` held for each remote provider type it calls when it was stored. Its figures are shown only when each had one then, and the file still holds it: otherwise it reads "not published: disclosure pending", with its scope shown and its figures not, until it is run again (`--again`). A local configuration is deterministic: one replicate, no flips.
- **"stale: another model reported":** a result whose replicates reported more than one model of a type, or one for which a later run of the same model type reports another model: a result or a canary, of any pack or configuration, the same day included.
- **Canaries** (section 12), run by hand: a seeded draw of 30 `test` cases. One that shows drift marks "stale: canary drift" the remote results of its pack's arm measured before it (on any set), and those measured no later than the replicates it was compared with.

Grading method mendari.grading/1.0 (sha256 `59d28c87024baad14e395b1b3329fec6a4d7685404789b05e93f688b3c3be40a`). Proportions are k of n [exact 95% interval, Clopper-Pearson]; means are value [95% bootstrap interval, 2,000 resamples, seed 0].
